messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Adult Bupropion Dose for Depression:
Immediate-release tablets:
The initial dose is 100 mg orally twice a day.
If necessary, increase the dose after 3 days to 100 mg orally three times a day.
Maintenance dose: 100 mg orally three times a day
The maximum dose is 450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses.
Single doses should not exceed 150 mg.
Immediate-release tablets should be given at least 6 hours apart.
Dose increases of the immediate-release tablet should not exceed 100 mg per day in a 3-day period.
Sustained-release tablets:
The initial dose is 150 mg orally once a day in the morning.
If necessary, increase the dose after 3 days to 150 mg orally twice a day.
Maintenance dose: 150 mg orally twice a day
Maximum dose: 400 mg/day; maximum single dose should not exceed 200 mg
Sustained-release oral tablets should be given at least 8 hours apart
Extended-release tablets:
The initial dose is 150 mg orally once a day in the morning.
If necessary, increase the dose to 300 mg orally once a day after 4 days.
Maintenance dose: 300 mg orally once a day
Maximum dose: 450 mg/day
Triplet: ["Bupropion", "has maintenance dose", "150 mg orally twice a day (sustained-release tablets)"]

The relation 'has maintenance dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is typically taken at the dose specified by the object entity for ongoing treatment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
C. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
